dogecoin.text: People who traded municipal bonds now trading junk bonds. People who invested in legacy companies now investing in speculative tech. People who invested in Bitcoin now go to Dogecoin. This is *exactly* what happens when you have cheap money sloshing around the economic system.

The hilarious thing about Bitcoin holders now hating Dogecoin is that it gets to the thing no one wants to acknowledge; and that is cheap money is pushing all investors out on the risk curve. Which is how bubbles start.
Genuinely funny to watch big Bitcoin people now having to talk about how stupid dogecoin is. The script writers are top notch

@mrdespicable22 Man there’s already a lot of conflating of “making quick money” with investing. The idea of 8% returns compounded over 30 years sounds a lot less glamorous than “Dogecoin in up 10,000% since January”
